reviews.title: Now everything is paid.
reviews.text: Used to love this app kept me motivated. Now since last update. Can’t do any challenges. Pops up and lets you only select 7 day free trial then have to pay.

reviews.title: Paying to invade others privacy is kind of psychotic
reviews.text:
I rarely get sketched out or have privacy concerns since there’s basically no such thing as privacy these days. However — the  premium function allowing you to view anybody’s profile and see how may steps somebody took on a random day 4 years ago was enough for me and my friends to abandon this app. It’s also very strange and sketchy that when you download the app it automatically populates your first and last name and your location. Basically automatically doxing you. 

You should be able to opt out of people paying to see your information- no matter how insignificant it may seem. This app is blatantly selling it.

reviews.title: On Track

reviews.title: Amazing App + Outstanding Support
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Strive for my step and activity challenges, and it has been awesome. The app is easy to use, and I love the different challenge types, I have a step, excercise and body fat % challenge going with my friends.
What really stood out, though, was the incredible support. I ran into an issue with one of my challenges, and they responded quickly, and got everything resolved right away.
I don’t do reviews very often (if at all) but wanted to thank the great support!

reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.text: We love the app and being able to compete against friends and family for motivation to workout. When there was an issue with the competitions we created after emailing customer service they responded and corrected the issue within 48 hours. Incredible considering most applications you never even get a response back. Highly recommended this app.

Appreciate the customer service too. It will be nice if more fitness trackers get compatible with this app. Looking forward to future updates.

reviews.title: The loss of Fitbit group challenges brought me here
reviews.text: This has been the closest app I’ve found that is similar to the Fitbit group competitions. Apple only offers person to person competitions, no group ones, and Fitbit no longer does group challenges. Here we’re able to compete in our groups like we would way back when Fitbit still did group challenges and it’s the best way to stay motivated. 10/10 recommend if you’re looking for something similar.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: I,along with my adult family, paid to use this app so we can compete against each other. It has been 3 weeks and after a lot of going back and forth with customer service, we just can’t get this to work.  Our smart scales register our measurements and they sync with our heath app, but it does not sync with strive.  All our data from our watches sync over, like steps, exercise, but we can’t get our weight to sync.  We have to manually input the data. All permissions are toggled yes, Bluetooth is enabled.  Out of 4 of us, we can’t get our weight to sync.  My son is a computer engineer and he can’t figure it out.  I do not recommend.

reviews.title: Almost there
reviews.text:
Could you please add relative goals for challenges like apple fitness? That way you can compete with people who typically do more or less. 

For instance, I don’t want to do a steps challenge with someone if I know I’m going to beat them everyday. However, if my goal is 12k steps and there’s is 8k, and points are awarded for how close you get to that goal or beyond it, then you can compete with anyone. Please add this feature!

reviews.title: Fantastic extrinsic motivator
reviews.text: Simple but effective. There isn’t a lot of variety, and I personally recommend only doing steps challenges or calorie based challenges because it is very easy to turn on your Apple Watch and let it sit and count every step you take as part of a workout in a day. So there are some people with like 6 to 8 hours a day of working out which is crazy but for the steps challenges and the calories challenges, it’s great. I think distance base challenges are good in theory but because I believe it also includes things like bicycles, a cyclist is gonna go way farther than any runner. Still, for its use, it is a fantastic resource, and source of motivation. Just getting involved with this app motivated me to increase my daily active steps from 16,000 to over 20,000 per day on average.

reviews.title: Very  nice and helpful app

reviews.title: Cool but weird restrictions
reviews.text: So I really enjoy the idea behind this app. My friends and I have a competition going and it’s really fun. However there are some weird quirks with this app that I don’t get. To enter your weight, you also have to enter your body fat percentage. You cannot just enter the weight. I wouldn’t guess that most people just know their percentage. And if you don’t have a smart scale or calipers at home, nothing in the app explains to you how to calculate an estimate like using the navy method. I wish it would have told me. I just wasn’t putting in weight because I didn’t know my BF%. It screwed up my competition because I wasn’t recording any data or progress. Once I finally found the formula for the navy estimate and tried to put it in, it logged that I had gained a bunch of weight because the starting weight wasn’t accurate. I could not find anywhere to go back and edit the starting weight. I assume editing isn’t easy for competition integrity, but I feel like it’s a necessary feature to have. I put in the wrong numbers initially so I was firmly in last place in every competition. I had been manually entering my weight into my apple health data but that does not sync to the app apparently. When I went to the help button to check the FAQ or send in a message, none of the buttons under help actually work. I clicked them all multiple times and was never pushed to the site or got any further response from the app.

reviews.title: Yes, finally a great competition app!
reviews.text: Not only is the app awesome but the developers are super responsive and the features are the best out of all the competition apps I found. None of the others are advanced as strive. All my data from my scale and activities are pulled in based on my selections and what I choose to share. You can join and create competitions. Very easy to use.

reviews.title: Keeps me aware of my activity level.
reviews.text: This is a great app. I have used it to better my awareness of my daily activity. Looking at my “rings” can get kinda boring. I love that I can actually view others workouts and get ideas and even push myself to do just a bit more!!! I am overweight and LOVE to eat too much. This pushes me toward activity and general awareness. Especially when competing with friends!!!!😁

reviews.title: Blatant cheating and nothing is done about it
reviews.text: Avoid this app. Has the same person winning by using a external device like the CUBII that shouldn’t even count for steps. It’s discouraging when for many months straight the same person cheating with a device is always on top. Ruins the purpose of competition and feels very unprofessional as app that is supposed to feel inclusive to everyone and their efforts. Multiple people have left the platform including myself because of this.

reviews.title: Only imperial system
reviews.text: Everything is in imperial metrics without a posibility to change it. If you are not american, don’t download it.

reviews.title: People cheat in competitions
reviews.text: No point in using this to actually compete. People get 100,000 to 200,000 steps a day (that’s about 40 to 80 miles) by sitting down and using devices to get extra steps without doing anything while openly admitting to it in the chats. These unrealistic numbers are seen and ignored by those in charge making it impossible to compete in a fun and enjoyable way. Plenty of other options that use common sense instead of a cave man “big number good” mentality.

reviews.title: Great app! Helpful motivator!
reviews.text: This app has been very helpful getting back into shape! Love the competitions! Helps keep me motivated and I’ve been crushing my weight loss goals! The app is easy to use and I have been recommending to everyone I know!
